stories.title: Gold slips as hotter US inflation data lifts Fed hike bets
stories.summary: Gold prices fell after a hotter-than-expected US inflation reading increased bets that the Federal Reserve could raise rates. Rising oil prices added to the inflation pressure, according to Investing.com.
stories.whyItMatters: A shift toward Fed hikes instead of cuts would raise the bar for risk assets and change the outlook for bonds and the dollar.
whatToWatch: The next US inflation report
The Fed's upcoming rate decision
Oil price moves that could add to inflation
questions: How much further could gold fall if hike bets keep building?
Will the Fed actually hike, or just hold rates longer?
